video_title: N3on Hoops With NBA Legend Delonte West!

quotes.speaker: Delonte West
quotes.summary_phrase: Delonte West on the importance of floor spacing and passing
quotes.excerpt: you supposed to get the ball down the floor as fast as you can even with the pass

text_blocks.speaker: Delonte West
text_blocks.text: I see a lot of guys playing the ball, playing the floor. The difference is when we played, you supposed to get the ball down the floor as fast as you can even with the pass. Get the ball up the floor. There is no walking the ball down the floor. What I see, Jalen Brunson does a lot and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander does this a lot when he plays. Just because the defender stops here, that does not mean where you stop. If I can take this ball and walk it all the way to the rim, you would do it.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: So wait, can you show me real quick? I'm Shaq.

quotes.speaker: Delonte West
quotes.summary_phrase: Delonte West on the fundamentals of scoring and passing
quotes.excerpt: it is less dribbles as possible, get to your shot. One dribble layup, one dribble pull-up

text_blocks.speaker: Delonte West
text_blocks.text: When you work with young players, try to catch the ball and get the outlet as far as they can, and it is less dribbles as possible, get to your shot. One dribble layup, one dribble pull-up, full court. That is how you work on your game. It is not all the drills. Do this if you want to get shifty. You can be shifty all you want, but once I go past you with one dribble, what is all that crossover mean?

quotes.speaker: Delonte West
quotes.summary_phrase: Delonte West on post-up positioning for guards
quotes.excerpt: I see post players, big guys, they be on the block. By the time you get them

text_blocks.speaker: Delonte West
text_blocks.text: I see post players, big guys, they be on the block. By the time you get them the post, they catch it and go like this, and they way out here. Then they trying to do all this. The game is old school, so I am making you a better player already.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: Yeah, I am learning. I might go to the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Delonte West
quotes.summary_phrase: Delonte West on the importance of shot selection and spacing
quotes.excerpt: you should already have sense and things that you know to do based on the team

text_blocks.speaker: Delonte West
text_blocks.text: You should already have sense and things that you know to do based on the team that you have, based on the scoring situation, who got it going, where is your best shooter at. And all that stuff, you should already know. You should already be a great extra player, a Steve Kerr to a Michael Jordan. Someone that can, you know, and then when we need you to hit that shot, you know how to get to your spot and be there available for him.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: But you're the best shooter in this situation. You're the best person on the court.

quotes.speaker: Delonte West
quotes.summary_phrase: Delonte West on LeBron James's playmaking and leadership
quotes.excerpt: I am going to give it to LeBron James, and he is going to do something

text_blocks.speaker: Delonte West
text_blocks.text: I am going to give it to LeBron James, and he is going to do something and pull up. I am going to command you to get the ball because you are the best playmaker also. So we should already be knowing if you know that I can shoot, I know that in this type of situation, you are the best playmaker. So somehow we already know that together.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: I'm the one to tell West and you're LeBron. Here you go.
